title: the summer heat has been burning through
excerpt: And there goes the first few weeks of junior year
body:
As much as one would say that junior year is one of the hardest years of your school time, I have been quite enjoying my classes this year. All my teachers are fun and all the friends I have are the type to make me grow and keep me accountable of my actions. It's almost like I've only just gotten my stability after moving places and I like that feeling of knowing what your doing and just hustling your way through your life. It's what makes me, me.

And as far as ISM concerns, I've been on top of everything I do, if not working ahead, so that I can start off with my study as soon as possible, for which I'm excited for. I've been going to the Davis Library and looking through books related to animal behaviour and psychology studies, and it is pretty fun to know what goes through their tiny little brains. But one point of growth I'd like to remind myself would be based on the speeches we did the other day. Even though my friends gave me a pretty good score, I feel like I could've done a lot more better if I was a little less nervous and that definitely needs some work.

For my next two weeks, I'm excited for my FCCLA CEAT Interview which is for the national board that I qualified for and bring our school up in the big fccla leagues. Plus, who wouldn't be excited for a 4 day weekend apart from Vibhum..

And there goes the first few weeks of junior year..
